purpose: Use read-only IBKR account summary, positions, and open orders as the live budget context for M108 paper execution-readiness ticket drafts without submitting orders.

account_snapshot.account_selection: If --account is not provided, select the account with the largest NetLiquidation value instead of sorting account IDs alphabetically.
non_blocking_error_notes: Market data farm OK status messages were reported by IBKR.
HMDS farm inactive-until-demand status was reported by IBKR.
IBKR read-only API mode rejected at least one request validation path, confirming the live API session is not order-enabled.

interpretation.status: Read-only IBKR account integration succeeded, but current fixed-size paper tickets are too large for the selected live account budget under conservative M109 limits.
interpretation.finding: The binding failures are per-trade risk, per-symbol risk, gross notional, and cash usage. This is expected when fixed paper ticket sizes are applied directly to a smaller live account.
interpretation.recommendation: Add account-scaled position sizing before any live or paper order staging. The next milestone should resize stock quantity, stop-loss proxy, and option spread width/risk to fit account equity and cash budgets before re-running readiness.
